name: presubmit
description: Catches the common manuscript submission mistakes before a journal does — missing sections, incomplete author/affiliation/email info, over-long abstracts and bad keyword counts, reference problems (duplicates by DOI or text, missing years, malformed DOIs, in-text citations with no matching reference, references never cited), and missing ethics/disclosure statements (conflict of interest, funding, human subjects, informed consent), plus deterministic language/typography errors. Reads .docx/.pdf/.tex/.txt, applies a journal profile (Cureus built in), and prints a severity-ranked readiness report with fix hints. Offline and deterministic — no language model, no spell dictionary, so no false positives on medical terms.
